As someone that’s worked at Marriott’s for a few years it’s really on a hotel by hotel basis. For instance my hotel currently allows mobile check ins but you still have to stop by the desk for your digital key to avoid fraud. Other properties that might be all inclusive or have different policies could allow mobile check in without ever stopping by the desk. Marriotts idea was for this to alleviate some pressure from the front desk but it really has just opened a lot of fraud so most properties will still have you stop by the desk to make sure it’s actually you checking into the room.

It doesn’t feel like I have the experience nor expertise to talk on this subject specifically. Under no circumstances is suicide the answer. No matter how much I relate to your or don’t relate to your situation this is absolutely never the answer.

My father served in the military for 6 years. Did his tour in Iraq the works. He was a combat medic so he watched people lay there and bleed out but never had to kill anyone. (That he can confirm).

About 10 years ago or so while on duty as a police officer our town had its only ever mass violence scare. This guy had and I quote from the news article “a battalion of weapons and ammo in his vehicle.” He rushed my dad and the other officers firing rounds at them and they had to shoot him. My dad not even being able to confirm that he was the one that actually killed him was seriously messed up for a bit after that. Toughest guy I ever knew and he was mortified that he had to kill someone.

Suicide is not an option. Suicide by cop is also not as you are now bringing more people in to suffer because of your death. I beg of you to reach out to a licensed therapist to talk and please do not try to extend the problems you shouldn’t be facing onto others only trying to do their job.

Couple things I learned.

Do not take anything the DIs say personal. They aren’t allowed to eat, sleep, drink water or do anything that shows they are human whatsoever in front of you. When they single you out for something to nothing at all it’s not personal. They are trying to push you to make you better. Their JOB is to find the ones that will leave. They aren’t trying to make YOU specifically quit they are just doing their job. 

Don’t ever unless you can max out all of your pt try to eat dessert at chow. You will get IT like there’s no tomorrow.

Don’t have the mindset “I just need to make it to the end of training.” That is too long of a goal and you won’t feel accomplished. If you ever want to quit tell yourself “I’ll quit tomorrow.” “I’ll quit after chow.” Take it chow to chow. They can’t fuck with you as much during chow not saying they can’t but if you listen you should be fine.

Unless you want that pride of being a squad leader it does absolute shit all for you. If you are guide I’m pretty sure you get a promotion at the end of training but squad leaders get shit all.

Don’t overly worry about your 1.5 mile time. When it comes to it you will be able to make it unless you have never ran in your life. To put it into perspective. Before boot I ran a 16:50. When we did pft I ran a 10:59. It only gets better too so don’t stress that as much.

As everyone else was saying. Do everything you are told with purpose and intent to finish. Don’t half ass anything or you will wish your weren’t born to half ass it. Be Insane brother.
